not_found.name: Unknown
description: Unable to find the requested ninja trick.

bleeding_attack.name: Bleeding Attack
description: ::ab{title="&L&Bleeding Attack (Ex)&FN&" icon=boost ability="A ninja with this trick can cause living opponents to ‹rule/bleed› by hitting them with a sneak attack. This attack causes the target to take 1 additional point of damage each round for each die of the ninja's sneak attack. Bleeding creatures take that amount of damage every round at the start of each of their turns. The bleeding can be stopped by a DC 15 Heal check or the application of any effect that heals hit point damage." special="Bleed damage from this ability does not stack with itself. Bleed damage bypasses any DR the creature might possess."}

ki_block.name: Ki Block
description: ::ab{title="&L&Ki Block (Su)&FN&" icon=lower flavor="A ninja with this trick can prevent a creature from using its ki pool." ability="Whenever the ninja deals sneak attack damage, the target must make a Will save or be unable to spend any points from its ki pool for a number of rounds equal to the ninja's Charisma modifier. The DC of this save is 10 + 1/2 the ninja's level + the ninja's Charisma modifier." special="The number of points in the target's ki pool is unaffected, and abilities that do not require the subject to spend ki still function."}

pressure_points.name: Pressure Points
description: ::ab{title="&L&Pressure Points (Su)&FN&" icon=boost flavor="A ninja with this trick can strike at an opponent's vital *pressure points,* causing weakness and intense pain." ability="Whenever the ninja deals sneak attack damage, she also deals 1 point of ‹rule/Strength or »Dexterity damage›, decided by the ninja." special="Unlike normal ability damage, this damage can be healed by a DC 15 Heal check. Each successful check heals 1 point of damage caused by this trick. A ninja with this trick receives a +10 insight bonus on this Heal check."}

slow_reactions.name: Slow Reactions
description: ::ab{title="&L&Slow Reactions (Ex)&FN&" icon=lower ability="Opponents that are damaged by the ninja's sneak attack can't make attacks of opportunity for 1 round."}

deadly_range.name: Deadly Range
description: ::ab{title="&L&Deadly Range (Ex)&FN&" icon=boost-ranged ability="A ninja with this ninja trick increases the range at which she can deal sneak attack damage by 10 feet." special="A ninja can take this trick more than once. Its effects stack."}

acrobatic_master.name: Acrobatic Master
description: ::ab{title="&L&Acrobatic Master (Su)&FN&" icon=boost swift="A ninja with this trick can focus her ki to grant her a +20 bonus on one Acrobatics check of her choice made before the start of her next turn." special="Using this ability expends 1 ki point from her ki pool."}

high_jumper.name: High Jumper
description: ::ab{title="&L&High Jumper (Ex)&FN&" icon=boost passive="When a ninja with this trick makes a ‹skill/high jump»<acrobatics›, the DC for that jump is half the normal DC." prereq="‹ninjatrick/Acrobatic master›"}

blood_debt.name: Blood Debt
description: ::ab{title="&L&Blood Debt (Su)&FN&" icon=power-protect-def ability="A ninja with this ability gains ‹feat/In Harm's Way› as a bonus feat, even if she doesn't meet the prerequisites." ability2="When the ninja intercepts an attack using this feat, she can spend 1 ki point to impose a *blood debt* on the aided ally. The ninja's ki pool is reduced by 1 until she ends this effect, which she may do as an @HLimmediate_action. If the ninja ends the *blood debt* in response to a successful attack against her by a creature the indebted ally threatens, the ally (who must be willing) takes full damage from that attack and any associated effects instead of the ninja." order=a2}

breath_of_the_ancestors.name: Breath of the Ancestors
description: ::ab{title="&L&Breath of the Ancestors (Su)&FN&" order=cs icon=cone-line choice="The ninja chooses one ‹family/imperial dragon› type (forest, sea, sky, sovereign, or underworld) when she gains this trick, and the choice can't be changed." standard="She can use supplies similar to those used for ninja ‹ninjatrick/smoke bomb«s› to produce an alchemical breath weapon that deals the same kind of damage as the selected dragon (piercing damage for forest dragons, fire for sea dragons, and so on).~~~The breath weapon deals the same amount of damage as the ninja's sneak attack, with a Reflex save allowed for half damage. The breath weapon is a 15-foot cone (or a 30-foot line if the underworld dragon is selected). The save DC is equal to 10 + 1/2 the ninja's class level + the ninja's Intelligence modifier." special="Using this ability expends up 2 ki points, and once used it cannot be used again for 1d4 rounds."}

darkvision.name: Darkvision
description: ::ab{title="&L&Darkvision (Su)&FN&" icon=power ability="This trick allows the ninja to use her ki to enhance her sight, granting *darkvision* out to a range of 60 feet." special="Using this trick is a @HLstandard_action that costs 1 ki point. The enhanced senses last for 1 hour."}

feather_fall.name: Feather Fall
description: ::ab{title="&L&Feather Fall (Su)&FN&" icon=magic immediate="The ninja can slow her descent as if using ‹spell/feather fall›. This ability uses her ninja level as the caster level." special="Each use of this ability uses up 1 ki point."}

flurry_of_stars.name: Flurry of Stars
description: ::ab{title="&L&Flurry of Stars (Ex)&FN&" icon=ranged-boost-down swift="A ninja with this ability can expend 1 ki point from her ki pool before she makes a full-attack attack with ‹eq-weapon/shuriken›. During that attack, she can throw two additional shuriken at her highest attack bonus, but all of her shuriken attacks are made at a -2 penalty, including the two extra attacks."}

forgotten_trick.name: Forgotten Trick
description: ::ab{title="&L&Forgotten Trick (Ex)&FN&" icon=power flavor="A ninja with this ability can recall one trick taught to her by her ancient masters." ability="When she uses this ability, she selects one ninja trick (not a *master trick* or *rogue talent*) that she does not know and can use that ninja trick for a number of rounds equal to her level. She must pay any ki costs associated with the trick as normal." special="Using this ability expends 2 ki point from her ki pool, plus the ki cost of the trick she chooses."}

herbal_compound.name: Herbal Compound
description: ::ab{title="&L&Herbal Compound (Ex)&FN&" icon=down-def flavor="A ninja with this trick can consume specially prepared herbs to strengthen her mind." move="The ninja can spend 1 ki point and smoke, eat, or inject an *herbal compound.* The ninja takes a -2 penalty to AC and on Reflex saves but gains a +4 alchemical bonus on Will saves for 10 minutes per ninja level."}

kamikaze.name: Kamikaze
description: ::ab{title="&L&Kamikaze (Su)&FN&" icon=boost flavor="A ninja with this ability strikes without concern for her own well-being." ability="The ninja can spend 1 point from her ki pool to give her unarmed strikes and any weapons she wields the ‹magic-enh/vicious› weapon special ability for 1 round per level." special="The ninja can spend 1 ki point to dismiss this effect."}

ki_charge.name: Ki Charge
description: ::ab{title="&L&Ki Charge (Su)&FN&" icon=ranged standard="A ninja with this trick can invest a portion of her ki into a single thrown weapon, such as a ‹eq-weapon/shuriken›, and throw it. The thrown weapon explodes on impact in a 5-foot ‹misc/burst›, dealing 1d6 points of fire damage. Creatures caught in the blast receive a Reflex save to halve the damage. The DC of this save is 10 + 1/2 the ninja's level + the ninja's Charisma modifier.~~~If the thrown weapon hits a creature, that creature takes a -2 penalty on the saving throw. If the thrown weapon misses, treat it as a ‹rule/throw«n» splash weapon›." special="Using this ability expends 1 ki point from her ki pool." incrementPlain="The fire damage~2~4" incrementEnd="d6."}

ki_venom.name: Ki Venom
description: :::ab{title="&L&Ki Venom (Ex)&FN&" icon=power-lower flavor="A ninja with this trick knows how to make poisons from innocuous herbs or minerals." action=Ability special="The ninja can spend additional ki as part of the process of creating the *ki venom* to improve the venom in one or more of the following ways: spend 1 ki point to increase the damage die to a d6, spend 1 ki point to change the ability damage dealt to Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma damage, or spend 1 ki point to increase the number of saves required to cure the poison by 1."}

Creating *ki venom* is a @HL[full-round action] that costs 1 ki point. The poison lasts for 24 hours before becoming inert. The poison deals either ‹rule/Strength or »Dexterity damage›, chosen when the venom is created.
::aff[Ki Venom]{iconP poison type=injury dcF dcLev=ninja dcIt=her dcMod=Cha freq="1/round for a number of rounds equal to the ninja's Charisma modifier" effStr="1d4" effDex="1d4" effOr cure1}

shadow_clone.name: Shadow Clone
description: ::ab{title="&L&Shadow Clone (Su)&FN&" icon=def-magic standard="The ninja can create 1d4 shadowy duplicates of herself that conceal her true location. This ability functions as ‹spell/mirror image›, using the ninja's level as her caster level." special="Using this ability costs 1 ki point."}

smoke_bomb.name: Smoke Bomb
description: ::ab{title="&L&Smoke Bomb (Ex)&FN&" icon=power-zap standard="This ability allows a ninja to throw a *smoke bomb* that creates a cloud of smoke with a 15-foot radius. This acts like the smoke from a ‹eq-misc/smokestick›. The ninja can center this smoke on herself, or throw the bomb as a ranged touch attack with a range of 20 feet." special="Each use of this ability uses up 1 ki point."}

poison_bomb.name: Poison Bomb
description: ::ab{title="&L&Poison Bomb (Ex)&FN&" icon=power ability="Whenever the ninja throws a *smoke bomb,* she can decide to include 1 dose of any inhaled poison she possesses. This poison affects all creatures in the smoke and lasts as long as the smoke lasts. She must pay for the poison normally." prereq="‹ninjatrick/Smoke bomb›"}

choking_bomb.name: Choking Bomb
description: ::ab{title="&L&Choking Bomb (Ex)&FN&" icon=power-lower ability="Whenever a ninja throws a *smoke bomb,* all living creatures in the resulting cloud must make a Fortitude save or become ‹misc/staggered› by the choking black smoke for 1d4 rounds. The DC of this saving throw is equal to 10 + 1/2 the ninja's level + the ninja's Charisma modifier. The ninja can decide to create an ordinary *smoke bomb* or add poison to this *smoke bomb* as normal." prereq="‹ninjatrick/Poison bomb›"}

strangler.name: Strangler
description: ::ab{title="&L&Strangler (Ex)&FN&" icon=melee ability="A ninja with this trick knows how to use a scarf, usually with a coin or large knot, as a lethal ‹eq-weapon/garrote›. The ninja takes no penalties when using a scarf as an improvised garrote." free="In addition, when attempting a grapple combat maneuver check, the ninja can spend 1 ki point to gain the ‹umr/constrict› special attack on that maneuver with damage equal to half the ninja's sneak attack dice (minimum 1d6)." order=af}

sudden_disguise.name: Sudden Disguise
description: ::ab{title="&L&Sudden Disguise (Su)&FN&" icon=magic swift="A ninja can change her appearance for 1 minute per level. This ability functions as ‹spell/disguise self›. Each use of this ability uses up 1 ki point."}

vanishing_trick.name: Vanishing Trick
description: ::ab{title="&L&Vanishing Trick (Su)&FN&" icon=magic swift="The ninja can disappear for 1 round per level. This ability functions as ‹spell/invisibility›. Using this ability uses up 1 ki point."}

ventriloquism.name: Ventriloquism
description: ::ab{title="&L&Ventriloquism (Su)&FN&" icon=magic swift="The ninja can throw her voice as if using the spell ‹spell/ventriloquism›. She can use this ability for 1 minute per ninja level. Each use of this ability uses up 1 ki point."}

arcane_backfire.name: Arcane Backfire
description: ::ab{title="&L&Arcane Backfire (Su)&FN&" icon=lower ability="When a ninja with this trick successfully attacks a creature that is holding a magic item that has a number of charges or uses per day, she can attempt a ‹skill/Use Magic Device› check (DC = 20 + the item's CL) to cause the item to lose either one daily use or a number of charges equal to the number of the ninja's sneak attack dice."}

combat_trick.name: Combat Trick
description: ::ab{title="&L&Combat Trick (Ex)&FN&" icon=power ability="A ninja who selects this trick gains a bonus ‹main/combat feat›."}

fast_stealth.name: Fast Stealth
description: ::ab{title="&L&Fast Stealth (Ex)&FN&" icon=boost ability="A ninja with this trick can move at full speed using the Stealth skill without penalty."}

hidden_weapons.name: Hidden Weapons
description: ::ab{title="&L&Hidden Weapons (Ex)&FN&" icon=boost flavor="A ninja with this ability can easily conceal weapons on her body." ability="The ninja adds her level on opposed Sleight of Hand checks made to conceal a weapon. In addition, she can draw hidden weapons as a @HLmove_action, instead of as a standard action."}

redirect_force.name: Redirect Force
description: ::ab{title="&L&Redirect Force (Ex)&FN&" icon=down-boost ability="If the ninja has a feat that allows her to attempt a combat maneuver without provoking attacks of opportunity, she can choose to provoke them anyway when she performs that maneuver. If she does so and takes damage from the attack of opportunity, the ninja adds the damage as a bonus on her attack roll instead of as a penalty."}

rogue_talent.name: Rogue Talent
description: ::ab{title="&L&Rogue Talent&FN&" icon=power ability="The ninja can select a ‹ability/rogue talent› in place of a ninja trick. The ninja cannot select a rogue talent that has the same name as a ninja trick." special="The ninja can select this talent multiple times."}

slow_metabolism.name: Slow Metabolism
description: ::ab{title="&L&Slow Metabolism (Ex)&FN&" icon=def flavor="The ninja has a slower-than-normal metabolism." ability="She can ‹misc/hold her breath› for twice as long as normal before needing to make Constitution checks (four times her Constitution score)." order=ap passive="In addition, whenever the ninja is poisoned, the time between saving throws (the poison's frequency) is doubled. Thus, a poison that has a frequency of *1/round for 6 rounds* would instead be *1/2 rounds for 12 rounds.*"}

style_master.name: Style Master
description: ::ab{title="&L&Style Master&FN&" icon=power ability="A ninja who selects this ninja trick gains a ‹main/style feat› that she qualifies for as a bonus feat."}

swarming_attack.name: Swarming Attack
description: ::ab{prereq="‹race/Ratfolk›, *swarming* racial trait" title="&L&Swarming Attack&FN&" icon=boost flavor="Ratfolk ninjas use their large numbers to overwhelm their enemies with countless attacks." ability="While using the swarming racial trait to share a space with an ally, a ninja with this talent gains a bonus on damage roles equal to the number of sneak attack dice her ally has. For example, a ninja would gain +3 damage if her ally has sneak attack 3d6."}

swift_poisoner.name: Swift Poisoner
description: ::ab{title="&L&Swift Poisoner (Ex)&FN&" icon=boost ability="A ninja with this trick can apply a dose of poison to a weapon as a @HLswift_action."}

unarmed_combat_training.name: Unarmed Combat Training
description: ::ab{title="&L&Unarmed Combat Training (Ex)&FN&" icon=power-melee ability="A ninja who selects this ninja trick gains ‹feat/Improved Unarmed Strike› as a bonus feat."}

deflect_arrows.name: Deflect Arrows
description: ::ab{title="&L&Deflect Arrows (Ex)&FN&" icon=power ability="A ninja who selects this ninja trick gains the ‹feat/Deflect Arrows› feat as a bonus feat." prereq="‹feat/Improved Unarmed Strike› (whether from ‹ninjatrick/unarmed combat training› trick or not)"}

snatch_arrows.name: Snatch Arrows
description: ::ab{title="&L&Snatch Arrows&FN&" icon=def-power ability="A ninja who selects this ninja trick gains the ‹feat/Snatch Arrows› feat as a bonus feat." prereq="‹feat/Improved Unarmed Strike› (whether from ‹ninjatrick/unarmed combat training› or not), ‹feat/Deflect Arrows› (whether from ‹ninjatrick/deflect arrows› trick or not)"}

undetected_sabotage.name: Undetected Sabotage
description: ::ab{title="&L&Undetected Sabotage (Ex)&FN&" icon=power ability="Whenever a ninja with this trick uses ‹skill/Disable Device› to sabotage or disable a device, she can make a ‹skill/Stealth› check with a bonus equal to her level. Anyone who inspects the device does not notice the sabotage and assumes the object works unless he beats the ninja's check with an opposed ‹skill/Perception› skill check."}

wall_climber.name: Wall Climber
description: ::ab{title="&L&Wall Climber (Su)&FN&" icon=power ability="A ninja with this ability gains a climb speed of 20 feet, but only on vertical surfaces. This ability cannot be used to scale perfectly smooth surfaces or to climb on the underside of horizontal surfaces."}

weapon_training.name: Weapon Training
description: ::ab{title="&L&Weapon Training (Ex)&FN&" icon=power ability="A ninja who selects this ninja trick gains ‹feat/Weapon Focus› as a bonus feat."}

assassinate.name: Assassinate
description: ::ab{title="&L&Assassinate (Ex)&FN&" icon=power-lower flavor="A ninja with this master trick can kill foes that are unable to defend themselves." ability="To attempt to *assassinate* a target, the ninja must first study her target for 1 round as a @HLstandard_action.~~~On the following round, if the ninja makes a sneak attack against the target and the target is denied its Dexterity bonus to AC, the sneak attack has the additional effect of possibly killing the target. This attempt automatically fails if the target recognizes the ninja as an enemy.~~~If the sneak attack is successful and the target of this attack fails a Fortitude save, it dies. The DC of this save is equal to 10 + 1/2 the ninja's level + the ninja's Charisma modifier.~~~If the save is successful, the target still takes the sneak attack damage as normal, but it is immune to that ninja's *assassinate* ability for 1 day."}

blinding_bomb.name: Blinding Bomb
description: ::ab{title="&L&Blinding Bomb (Ex)&FN&" icon=lower ability="Whenever the ninja throws a ‹ninjatrick/smoke bomb›, all living creatures in the cloud must make a Fortitude save or be ‹misc/blinded› by the black smoke for 1d4 rounds. The DC of this saving throw is equal to 10 + 1/2 the ninja's level + the ninja's Charisma modifier." special="This trick cannot be combined with a *choking bomb,* but the ninja can combine a *blinding bomb* with a ‹ninjatrick/poison bomb›." prereq="‹ninjatrick/Choking bomb›"}

fractured_mirror.name: Fractured Mirror
description: ::ab{title="&L&Fractured Mirror (Su)&FN&" icon=def-magic-boost flavor="By sending phantom selves across the battlefield, one may fight as many." ability="When a ninja with this trick uses the *shadow clone* ninja trick, she gains an additional clone for every 3 ninja levels she has, to a maximum of eight clones.~~~In addition, while she has *shadow clones* deployed, the ninja can cause any number of her clones to split from herself as part of a @HLmove_action. The *shadow clones* move up to the ninja's speed at her will each time she uses a move action to move. *Shadow clones* separated in this way are not considered part of the *shadow clone* trick until they return to the ninja's square, though they can still be destroyed while separated." special="*Shadow clones* separated from the ninja have an AC equal to the ninja's AC - 5 and cannot take any actions, though they can provide ‹rule/flanking›. *Shadow clones* do not occupy any space and a creature can freely enter a *shadow clone's* square." prereq="‹ninjatrick/Shadow clone›"}

greater_ki_venom.name: Greater Ki Venom
description: ::ab{title="&L&Greater Ki Venom (Ex)&FN&" icon=boost ability="A ninja with this trick can further improve her *ki venom.* The ninja can spend 2 ki points to increase the damage die to a d8 or spend 2 ki points to change the ability damage dealt to ‹rule/Constitution damage›." prereq="‹ninjatrick/Ki venom›"}

invisible_blade.name: Invisible Blade
description: ::ab{title="&L&Invisible Blade (Su)&FN&" icon=magic ability="Whenever a ninja uses the *vanishing trick* ninja trick, she is treated as if she were under the effects of ‹spell/greater invisibility›." prereq="‹ninjatrick/Vanishing trick›"}

master_disguise.name: Master Disguise
description: ::ab{title="&L&Master Disguise (Su)&FN&" order=a2 icon=boost flavor="A ninja with this trick can take on the appearance of other creatures and individuals." ability="Whenever the ninja uses the *sudden disguise* ninja trick, the duration increases to 10 minutes per level." ability2="Alternatively, the ninja can use the *sudden disguise* ninja trick to take on the appearance of a specific individual that the ninja has seen before for 1 minute per level. Creatures that are familiar with the individual receive a Will saving throw to see through the illusion. The DC of this saving throw is 10 + 1/2 the ninja's level + the ninja's Charisma modifier.~~~This illusion also changes the ninja's speech, if she has heard the individual talk and can speak his language." prereq="‹ninjatrick/Sudden disguise›"}

shadow_split.name: Shadow Split
description: ::ab{title="&L&Shadow Split (Su)&FN&" icon=def-magic ability="This trick allows the ninja to create an illusory double of herself that moves away from her, allowing the ninja to create a distraction. When she uses this ability, an illusory double appears and moves away from the ninja, heading in one direction.~~~The double climbs walls, jumps pits, or simply passes through obstacles, moving at twice the ninja's speed in the direction indicated by the ninja when the ability is used. Its course cannot be changed.~~~The double persists for 1 round per level of the ninja. Those who interact with the double receive a Will saving throw to recognize that it is fake. The DC of this save is 10 + 1/2 the ninja's level + the ninja's Charisma modifier." special="Each use of this ability uses up 1 ki point." prereq="‹ninjatrick/Shadow clone›"}

acceleration_of_form.name: Acceleration of Form
description: ::ab{title="&L&Acceleration of Form (Su)&FN&" icon=def-boost standard="A ninja with this trick can spend 1 ki point to gain the benefits of ‹spell/displacement› and ‹spell/haste› for 1 round per 2 ninja levels."}

deep_cover.name: Deep Cover
replacements: ::ab{next flavor="Text from the vigilante class ability." title="Dual Identity (Ex)" icon=power-def ability="You hide your true identity, allowing you to move about social circles and nobility without carrying the stigma of your ruthless actions. In effect, you have two identities: one is a polite member of society while the other is a skilled and cunning warrior. To keep up this charade, you usually have two names: your true name, used in polite company, and your vigilante name, used to strike fear in the hearts of those who oppose you. Knowledge checks about one do not reveal information about the other, unless your true identity is revealed to the world at large.~~~You can start each day in either of your identities, referred to simply as @HLsocial or @HLvigilante. Changing from one identity to another takes 1 minute and must be done out of sight from other creatures to preserve your secret. Changing identities is more than just changing outfits and clothing (although that is certainly a part of it); the process often also involves applying make-up, altering your hair, and adjusting other personal effects. Furthermore, the change is as much a state of mind as of body, so items such as a ‹magic-wondrous/hat of disguise› and similar spells and effects that change the user's appearance do not reduce the time required to change identities. Most *social talents* require you to be in your social identity, but a vigilante who uses *vigilante talents* in his social identity risks exposing his secret.~~~Despite being a single person, your dual nature allows you to have two alignments, one for each of your identities. When in an identity, you are treated as having that identity's alignment for all spells, magic items, and abilities that rely on alignment. For the purpose of meeting a qualification for a feat, class, or any ability, you are only eligible if both of your alignments meet the requirements. A vigilante's two alignments cannot be more than one step from each other on a single alignment axis. For example, a vigilante with a lawful neutral social identity could have a vigilante identity that is lawful good, lawful neutral, lawful evil, neutral, neutral good, or neutral evil. If you are the target of an effect that would change your alignment, it changes both of your alignments to the new alignment.~~~Any attempts to scry or otherwise locate you work only if you are currently in the identity the creature is attempting to locate (or if the creature knows that the two identities are the same individual). Otherwise, the spell or effect has no effect, revealing nothing but darkness, as if the target were invalid or did not exist."}

::ab[Seamless Guise (Ex)]{next flavor="Text from the vigilante class ability." icon=def ability="Should anyone suspect you of being anything other than what you appear to be while either in your social or vigilante identity, you can attempt a Disguise check with a +20 circumstance bonus to appear as your current identity, and not as your other identity."}
description: ::ab{title="&L&Deep Cover (Ex)&FN&" icon=power ability="A ninja with this trick gains the *dual identity* and *seamless guise* class feature as a ‹class/vigilante›, except that the ninja can spend 1 ki point to change identities as a @HLmove_action. The ninja's identities are referred to as social and ninja, rather than social and vigilante."}

many_guises.name: Many Guises
description: ::ab{title="&L&Many Guises (Ex)&FN&" order=anp icon=power ability="The ninja can take on any number of mundane guises. Whenever he changes his identity, he has a third option (instead of social or ninja): he can become mundane." info="The mundane identity is not a specific individual. Each one is created at the moment it is assumed, and quickly forgotten as soon as it is removed. While in a mundane identity, the ninja does not gain the benefit of either his social or ninja identity, but instead appears as a member of his race, usually a common laborer, farmer, or peasant of any gender. His alignment is treated as neutral when he is in his mundane identity." passive="While in this identity, he receives a +20 circumstance bonus on Disguise checks to appear like an ordinary member of his race. Spells and abilities that are looking for the ninja in either of his other identities fail while he is in his mundane identity." special="He must build the appearance for this identity using whatever clothing and tools he has at his disposal. While he can use magic (such as a ‹magic-wondrous/hat of disguise›), his mundane identity can never be anything other than an ordinary member of a society or large group (subject to GM discretion)." prereq="‹ninjatrick/Deep cover›"}

false_face.name: False Face
description: ::ab{title="&L&False Face (Su)&FN&" icon=power-magic flavor="Like ‹family/oni› who take mortal shapes to infiltrate society, some ninjas can mold their flesh to pass unsuspected." ability="A ninja with this trick gains the ‹umr/change shape› (any Small or Medium humanoid, ‹spell/alter self›) universal monster rule as long as she has at least 1 ki point."}

ghost_step.name: Ghost Step
description: ::ab{title="&L&Ghost Step (Su)&FN&" icon=power flavor="A ninja with this trick can pass through walls as if she were a ghost." swift="Until the end of her turn, she can pass through a wall or other surface that is up to 5 feet thick per level as if she were incorporeal. She must exit the solid material by the end of her turn." special="Each use of this ability uses up 1 ki point."}

kami_warden.name: Kami Warden
description: ::ab{title="&L&Kami Warden (Su)&FN&" icon=power-protect-def flavor="Ninjas can act as bodyguards as well as assassins or spies; some mystically emulate the relationship between ‹family/kami› and their wards when protecting their charges." ability="A ninja with this trick gains ‹feat/Bodyguard› and ‹feat/In Harm's Way› as bonus feats, ignoring their prerequisites." special="When using In Harm's Way to intercept an attack, the ninja can spend 1 ki point to gains DR 10/cold iron and resistance 10 to acid, electricity, and fire for that attack."}

kawarimi.name: Kawarimi
description: ::ab{title="&L&Kawarimi (Su)&FN&" icon=def immediate="Once per day when a successful attack is made against a ninja with this ability, she can spend 1 ki point to attempt a ‹skill/Stealth› check opposed by the attacker's ‹skill/Perception› check. The ninja can attempt this check while being observed as long as she has ‹rule/cover› or ‹rule/concealment› (or an ability that allows her to attempt Stealth checks without cover or concealment).~~~If she's successful, the opponent's attack hits an inanimate object that the attacker mistook for the ninja, and the ninja may move into an adjacent square and is hidden from the attacker."}

occulted_soul.name: Occulted Soul
description: ::ab{title="&L&Occulted Soul (Su)&FN&" icon=magic-def flavor="A ninja with this trick can still her mind to bypass magical detection." ability="The ninja can spend 1 ki point to cast ‹spell/nondetection› on herself as a spell-like ability, with a caster level equal to her ninja level."}

see_the_unseen.name: See the Unseen
description: ::ab{title="&L&See the Unseen (Su)&FN&" icon=magic flavor="A ninja with this trick learns how to see that which cannot be seen." swift="The ninja can cast ‹spell/see invisibility›, using her level as the caster level. Each use of this ability uses up 1 ki point."}

unbound_steps.name: Unbound Steps
description: ::ab{title="&L&Unbound Steps (Su)&FN&" icon=power flavor="This trick allows a ninja to use her ki to walk through the air." ability="Whenever the ninja uses the *light steps* class feature, she can walk on air, rising or descending as she desires. She must end her move on a solid surface." special="Each use of this ability uses up 1 ki point."}

advanced_talent.name: Advanced Talent
description: ::ab{title="&L&Advanced Talent&FN&" icon=power ability="The ninja can select a ‹ability/advanced_>rogue talent› from the list of Advanced Talents in place of a ninja trick. The ninja cannot select a rogue talent that has the same name as a ninja trick." special="The ninja cannot select ‹talent/improved evasion› unless she has ‹ability/evasion› (either as a class feature or as a ‹ninjatrick/ninja master trick»<evasion›)."}

all_the_stars_in_the_sky.name: All the Stars in the Sky
description: ::ab{title="&L&All the Stars in the Sky (Ex)&FN&" icon=power flavor="Certain master ninjas possess a seemingly limitless supply of their trusted weapons." ability="Whenever a ninja with this trick buys a set of 50 identical magic ‹eq-weapon/shuriken›, she thereafter replenishes them at no cost and never runs out. This stock of magical shuriken can be upgraded as though it were a normal magic weapon, and shuriken upgraded this way likewise never run out."}

deadly_shuriken.name: Deadly Shuriken
description: ::ab{title="&L&Deadly Shuriken (Ex)&FN&" icon=ranged-boost fullround="A ninja with this master trick can take careful aim and pool all of her attack potential into a single, deadly ‹eq-weapon/shuriken› throw. When she does this, she throws a single shuriken at a single target, but makes as many attack rolls as she can, based on her base attack bonus. She makes the attack rolls in order from highest bonus to lowest, as if she were making a full attack. If any of the attack rolls hit the target, the attack hits. For each additional successful attack roll beyond the first, the ninja increases the damage by 1d6." special="‹misc/Precision damage› and extra damage from weapon special abilities (such as ‹magic-enh/flaming›) are added with damage modifiers and are not increased by this advanced talent.~~~If one or more rolls are critical threats, she confirms the critical once using her highest base attack bonus -5. For each critical threat beyond the first, she reduces this penalty by 1 (to a maximum of 0)."}

evasion.name: Evasion
description: ::ab{title="&L&Evasion (Ex)&FN&" icon=def ability="A ninja can avoid even magical and unusual attacks with great agility. If she makes a successful Reflex saving throw against an attack that normally deals half damage on a successful save, she instead takes no damage." special="‹ability/Evasion› can be used only if the ninja is wearing light armor or no armor. A helpless ninja does not gain the benefit of *evasion.*"}

feat.name: Feat
description: ::ab{title="&L&Feat&FN&" icon=power ability="A ninja may gain any feat that she qualifies for in place of a ninja trick."}

spiritual_companion.name: Spiritual Companion
description: ::ab{title="&L&Spiritual Companion (Ex)&FN&" icon=power flavor="While ninjas are accustomed to solitude, some form pacts with magical beings to seek aid and advice." ability="A ninja with this trick gains an ‹feat/improved familiar›, treating her ninja level as her wizard level. The ninja can select any of the following as her familiar: ‹monster/calligraphy wyrm›, ‹monster/pipefox›, ‹monster/shikigami« kami›, or ‹monster/spirit oni›. The ninja must have an alignment compatible with the chosen familiar."}

unarmed_combat_mastery.name: Unarmed Combat Mastery
description: ::ab{title="&L&Unarmed Combat Mastery (Ex)&FN&" icon=melee-boost ability="A ninja who selects this trick deals damage with her unarmed strikes as if she were a ‹class/monk› of her ninja level - 4." special="If the ninja has levels in monk, this ability stacks with monk levels to determine how much damage she can do with her unarmed strikes." prereq="‹feat/Improved Unarmed Strike› (whether from ‹ninjatrick/unarmed combat training› or not)"}
